question.text: In a Development Impact Bond structure, typical Outcome Funders include all of the following EXCEPT:

answer.text: Senior secured debt-fund managers seeking market-rate fixed returns.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 2.3.1.2 (Table 2.1), typical Outcome Funders include CSR donors, Foundations, Retail Investors, and Government. These parties commit to pay-on-success because they seek impact, not financial yield. Senior secured debt-fund managers seeking market-rate returns do not fit because the outcome-funder role is NOT a secured-lending role — the outcome funder pays out only on verified impact. The Trap: Options A, B and C are explicitly listed in the chapter. Option D confuses the Risk Investor role (which DOES seek a 4-8% return) with the Outcome Funder role (which pays FOR that return). Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A/B/C/D/E (AIF) treats Cat I vs Cat II waterfall mechanics. V-A (MF Distributor) treats HNI philanthropic-vs-investment allocation.
